queries.query: 我這邊有一個育才專案的六份文件（招募、訓練、筆試、面試、專案實作、委員會），幫我整理成一份給委員會看的說明提綱。
queries.note: Core case: distill a document SET into one high-altitude 提綱 that points down to each source.

queries.query: 把這幾份規劃文件濃縮成一份，讓主管一眼看懂全貌、需要細節再往下翻的東西。
queries.note: Names the briefing shape (grasp the whole, drill for detail) without saying 提綱 literally.

queries.query: 訓練計劃書的時數改了，幫我把說明提綱對應的段落更新，並確認跟其他來源文件對齊。
queries.note: Re-sync branch: a source changed, update the affected sections and re-check consistency.

queries.query: 這個資安稽核專案有五份報告，幫我拉到同一個高度做成一份提綱，各段給重點再指向原報告。
queries.note: Generality: a non-training domain should still trigger — the skill is domain-neutral.

queries.query: 幫我擬一份系統汰換的簽呈，要有背景、方案比較、經費、風險跟建議事項。
queries.note: Authoring ONE formal document from scratch, not distilling a set. Routes to formal-doc-structure.

queries.query: 幫我寫這個雲端遷移案的需求規格書第三章「遷移與切換」的需求清單。
queries.note: RFP / 招標規格 authoring. Routes to rfp-writing.

queries.query: 幫我用白話跟不懂技術的主管解釋什麼是 RAG。
queries.note: Lowering one term/passage for a non-technical reader. Routes to plain-speak. (briefing-outline USES plain-speak internally on its sentences, but a bare term-lowering request is plain-speak's own job.)

queries.query: 幫我把這段提綱的 AI 味拿掉，「賦能」「全面提升」那種空話改掉，結構不用動。
queries.note: Pure language/voice cleanup with no structural work. Routes to avoid-ai-writing-zh.

queries.query: 這份 40 頁的評估報告，幫我摘要成一頁重點。
queries.note: Source count is not the criterion: distilling one long report into a high-altitude overview that points down to its sections is still briefing-outline. The altitude/point-down relationship is what triggers, not the number of documents.

queries.query: 下週三下午要不要一起吃個飯？
